note: Verda is the rebrand of DataCrunch (Helsinki, Finland-based GPU cloud, founded ~2018-2020 by Ruben Bryon). Raised a $64M Series A (2025-09, equity+debt; equity leads byFounders/Skaala/Varma/Tesi, debt led by Nordea/Armada Credit Partners), then further rounds in 2026 (~$117M April 2026 led by Lifeline Ventures, and reports of a ~$100M June 2026 raise) that press treats as building toward the $189M Series B announced 2026-09-22 led by Emergence Capital, crossing a $1B+ valuation (unicorn status). No evidence of YC or other accelerator participation despite DataCrunch's HN/YC-forum visibility as a cheap GPU-cloud product.
